summary: First-party discovery verified Guinea's title-registration procedure and national cadastral-coverage context, but no public general-land parcel service for Nzérékoré. The accessible ArcGIS service is a mining-cadastre country layer; the application layer requires a token.
queryOutcomes: English and French discovery queries are recorded verbatim in city-2308-nz-r-kor.json, with actual result URLs.
requestOutcomes: Official procedure, DGPEIP coverage page, municipal map HTML/current JavaScript, mining-cadastre REST metadata, one bounded country-layer query, and token-protected application metadata were requested. No credentials, private tokens, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
scopeLimits: National procedure and agency prose do not prove a local public parcel registry.
The municipal territorial map contains administrative points, not parcel polygons.
The mining-cadastre country layer is out of scope for ordinary cadastral parcels.
No exact WUP-point parcel test was possible; unavailable or out-of-scope services are not treated as citywide absence.
No raw source-specific attributes or parcel polygons were retained.

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified native land-parcel geometry response was available.

uncertainty: Parcel-level stable identity, schema, CRS, anonymous access, local coverage, and citywide completeness remain unverified.
